purpose: Real result of dispatching .github/workflows/fda-approval.yml, for NDA020793 (CAFCIT / caffeine citrate, sponsor HIKMA) -- the same real Drugs@FDA application tests/test_fda_approvals.py and tests/test_fda_ingestion.py already use as ground truth. Updated in place from this same day's first dispatch (run #1, commit 0b9fa35) after adding submission_class_code classification, superseding rather than leaving a stale duplicate beside it.
context: Like ClinicalTrials.gov (reports/m3-clinical-trial-workflow-result-2026-09-30.json) and unlike Milestone 3 Phase B's earnings-surprise pipeline (data.sec.gov's own paths confirmed blocked from GitHub Actions with HTTP 403, reports/m3-earnings-surprise-workflow-result-2026-09-30.json), openFDA's drugsfda.json endpoint succeeded on the very first real dispatch -- matching what local testing already predicted before any code was written. submission_class_code was added later the same day (commit 0616482): all 9 real submissions' own class codes are now classified correctly, verified against this fresh dispatch's own live output, which matches tests/test_fda_approvals.py's own real fixture exactly (LABELING x4, MANUF (CMC) x3, TYPE 2 x1 on the original application, EFFICACY x1).
not_a_claim: Not a claim about CAFCIT's own clinical or commercial significance -- 'approved'/'new_active_ingredient'/etc. describe each submission's own regulatory status and class only.
Not a general claim that every openFDA path is unblocked -- only this specific endpoint (drug/drugsfda.json, searched by application_number) has been confirmed working from GitHub Actions so far.

Not a claim that submission_class_code's own real enum is fully covered -- 24 of 27 real values are classified; UNKNOWN, BIOSIMILAR, and TYPE 10- BLA are deliberately left unclassified since no sampled real record (up to 50 each) populates their own submission_class_code_description field (nre/fda_approvals.py's own module docstring).

Not a claim that this project's own 23 accepted issuers have FDA-approved products in Drugs@FDA -- several smaller/clinical-stage biotech issuers searched during Phase C's connection work returned no matches, consistent with Drugs@FDA covering only approved applications. NDA020793 was used as an independently verifiable ground-truth example, not as one of this project's own issuers.
